inclusion_rule: Include speech or language decoders (recognition or synthesis) from a non-acoustic speech signal (EMG, EEG, ECoG, ultrasound, articulography, MRI, lip or face video) that are trained on input signals generated by a model from speech, text or another signal, alone or mixed with real recordings. Boundary: signal-level augmentation of real recordings (noise, warping, channel dropout, SpecAugment) is excluded; synthetic target speech is M02 and excluded; speech-to-articulation or talking-face generators that are not used to train a decoder count as pattern matches only; versions of one study count once.
